Will I get a replacement or a refund?

Sent · Just now

Horizn Studios KI Agent · AI

Horizn Studios KI Agent · AI says:

Whether you receive a replacement or a refund depends on your specific case:

Returns / exchanges: You send the item back via the Return Portal; after inspection, we issue a refund to your original payment method (usually within 8 business days). Direct exchanges aren’t possible; you place a new order separately.
Repairs / damage: We first assess the damage and warranty status. Many cases are repaired free of charge or resolved by sending replacement parts (e.g., wheels, handles, TSA lock). Some items may need to go to our Repair Center; in such cases we work with you individually to find the best solution, which can include repairs or replacement parts rather than a refund.

So you are not guaranteed a replacement or a refund by default; the outcome depends on whether it’s a return or a repair/warranty assessment and on the condition and warranty status of your product.
